title: Listings
description: Manage product and service listings for your tenant storefront.

help.title: About Listings
help.overview: A listing is a provider's offer on the marketplace — a service or gig with category, media, pricing, and optional packages or add-ons. Only an active listing can be ordered. Status is not changed by ordinary edit; activate and deactivate are dedicated actions.

sections.title: Status
items: Draft is the default while you build title, category, media, and price.
Activate requires a price and currency. Without them the listing cannot become orderable.
Deactivate takes an active listing offline without deleting it.
Only the listing's provider (or an admin) can activate or deactivate.
sections.body: Status is draft, active, or inactive. PATCH cannot change it.

sections.title: What you configure
items: Title, description, category, tags, FAQs, and buyer requirements describe the offer.
Pricing type is fixed or hourly. Price and currency power create-from-listing orders when no package is chosen.
Delivery days set the default due date window for orders from the listing base price.
Main image is required; galleries and location (country / state / city) are optional.
Packages and add-ons are separate records attached to the listing; they override or extend price and delivery when the buyer selects them.

sections.title: How it connects
items: Orders can be created from an active listing (optionally with a package and add-ons).
Promotions boost a listing's visibility for a date window.
Flags let users report a listing; resolving a flag can deactivate it.
Reviews roll up rating and review count on the listing.
Deleting is a soft delete and can be restored.
